text.p: McKesson Corp on Thursday said its unit, McKesson Health Systems, has signed a contract with two health care companies that could generate over $1.0 billion in sales over the deal's five year life.

The pact calls for McKesson to deliver pharmaceutical products to Capstone Pharmacy Services Inc and Stadtlanders Pharmacy. Capstone provides pharmacy services in 14 states to long-term care facilities containing about 120,000 beds. Stadtlanders provides specialty pharmaceutical care for individuals living with HIV/AIDS, organ transplants, oncology, infertility and other high-risk disease states.
Capstone and Stadtlanders are affiliates of Counsel Corp , a provider of home health care, institutional pharmacy and specialty pharmacy services.
